description: Test agent for the Go Kit spike. It keeps a notebook.
name: spike

skills.description: Test agent for the Go Kit spike. It keeps a notebook.
skills.name: model

skills.description: List the notes in the notebook, with their text.
skills.name: list_notes

skills.description: Write a note to the notebook. A person must approve each write.
skills.name: write_note

skills.description: List the DNS records in a Cloudflare zone. Use it before a change, to see the current records and their IDs.
skills.name: dns_list_records

skills.description: Create a DNS record in a Cloudflare zone. A person must approve the change. Give the type, the name and the value.
skills.name: dns_create_record

skills.description: Change an existing DNS record in a Cloudflare zone. A person must approve the change. Find the record ID first.
skills.name: dns_update_record

skills.description: Delete a DNS record from a Cloudflare zone. A person must approve the change. This cannot be undone.
skills.name: dns_delete_record

skills.description: Check if a domain name is available at the Cloudflare registrar, and give its price for one year.
skills.name: registrar_check_domain

skills.description: List the domains in the Cloudflare registrar account, with their expiry dates and auto-renew setting.
skills.name: registrar_list_domains

skills.description: Register a domain at the Cloudflare registrar. A person must approve the purchase and its price.
skills.name: registrar_register_domain

skills.description: List the OpenRouter API keys of the account, with their names, limits and usage. The keys are never shown.
skills.name: openrouter_list_keys

skills.description: Create an OpenRouter API key with a credit limit. The new key goes to the secret sink, never to the chat.
skills.name: openrouter_create_key

skills.description: Disable an OpenRouter API key. A person must approve the change. The key stops working at once.
skills.name: openrouter_disable_key

skills.description: List the names of the secrets in an Infisical folder. The values are never shown.
skills.name: infisical_list_secrets

skills.description: Set a secret in an Infisical folder. The value comes from the secret sink, never from the chat.
skills.name: infisical_set_secret

skills.description: List the machine identities of the Infisical organization, with their roles and projects.
skills.name: infisical_list_identities

skills.description: List the mailboxes of a domain on MXroute, with their quota and use.
skills.name: mxroute_list_mailboxes

skills.description: Create a mailbox on MXroute. A person must approve it. The password goes to the secret sink.
skills.name: mxroute_create_mailbox

skills.description: List the email forwarders of a domain on MXroute.
skills.name: mxroute_list_forwarders

skills.description: Create an email forwarder on MXroute. A person must approve it.
skills.name: mxroute_create_forwarder

skills.description: Search the agent's memory files for a word or a phrase, and give the matching lines.
skills.name: memory_search

skills.description: Add one line to a memory file of the agent. Use it to keep a fact for later sessions.
skills.name: memory_append
